_comment: Hosts the community-pack-validate.yml workflow is allowed to download pack_url from. Adding a host here is a trust-boundary decision (see scripts/fetch_pack.py for the enforcement it gets), not a mechanical edit -- review it like the workflow YAML itself. 'kind': 'direct' is a plain HTTPS GET with redirect re-validation; 'google-drive' additionally runs the two-step confirm-token dance Google Drive requires for files too large to virus-scan; 'mediafire' fetches the share page then the downloadN.mediafire.com CDN hop; 'dropbox' rewrites the share link's dl flag to dl=1 and follows the CDN redirects; 'mega' derives an AES-CTR key from the URL fragment, asks the MEGA API for a download URL and decrypts the stream (ADR-0187). Match is exact 'host' and/or 'host_ends_with' (first matching entry wins).
